name: AskMyDocs - AI Hub
subtitle: Answers from your documents
promotionalText: Bring your knowledge into focus. Ask questions with sources, browse project documents, and keep your conversations organized on your device.
description:
Find clarity in the documents your team already knows.

AskMyDocs connects to your AskMyDocs workspace so you can ask questions, read source documents, and explore project knowledge in one focused app.

ANSWERS WITH SOURCES
Ask a question about your project's knowledge base. Read the answer and open cited documents to check the source. AI-generated answers can be incomplete or incorrect; verify important information against the original documents.

A LIBRARY YOU CAN EXPLORE
Browse folders and canonical documents in the Knowledge library. Search document titles and paths, then read indexed source text in the document viewer. Knowledge browsing requires a compatible AskMyDocs server.

CONVERSATIONS, ORGANIZED
Keep conversations on your device. Rename them, pin the ones you need, archive completed work, and find a session by title. Copy an answer when you want to use it elsewhere. Conversation history is local and does not synchronize with the web app. Each question is sent independently to the server.

A CALM WORKSPACE
Choose a light or dark appearance and switch between the organizations and projects your account can access. The interface adapts to the available screen space.

ACCOUNT AND CONNECTION REQUIRED
An existing AskMyDocs account and project access are required. New accounts require a valid invitation code. Questions and retrieved content are processed by your connected AskMyDocs service and its configured AI providers. An internet connection is required for chat, search, and document retrieval.
whatsNew:
A new editorial look with a graphite and warm-ivory identity.

- New app icon and light/dark appearance.
- Browse project folders and canonical documents in Knowledge.
- Rename, pin, archive, restore, and search conversations on your device.
- Copy answers and open cited source documents.
- Keep the active chat when switching between sections.
- Improved error recovery, keyboard focus, and compact layouts.
betaAppDescription: AskMyDocs connects to an existing project knowledge base for source-grounded questions, document search, and reading. This beta adds the new visual identity, Knowledge browsing, and local session organization. A compatible AskMyDocs account, project membership, and internet connection are required.
betaWhatToTest: Test sign-in and tenant/project selection; light/dark appearance; document search; Knowledge folder browsing and source reading; chat citations and answer copying; local session renaming, pinning, archiving, restoration, and persistence after restart. Check safe areas and keyboard behavior on your device. Each question is independent; local history does not sync with the web app.
